name: Advanced Silk Science and Technology
description: Types of silk, Natural spinning process for B. mori silk and spider draglines; self-assembly, nanoconfinement and hierarchical structure of silkworm silk and spider silk proteins; mechanical, optical, acoustic properties, shape memory and viscoelastic behaviour of silks; moisture sorption and thermal properties of silks; recombinant silk and properties; structure and properties of sericin, advanced degumming techniques and recovery of sericin; Dissolving silk fibroin and purification; silk material architectures; physical and chemical crosslinking and modification strategies for silks; recombinant and regenerated silk spinning; biomimicry of silk materials; functionalized silk for advanced materials and technical textile development; Industrial case studies, evaluation of carbon footprint, life cycle assessment, circular economy approaches in silk production and processing.
